sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
a) Fit for the purpose: our premises achieve the following desired outcomes
- provide clean and pest free surrounding enhancing aesthetics and durable functions of council’s assets
- meet standards in maintain assets
- opportunities for cleaner and safer living environment
b) Bringing experience: provide advice, expertise and skills to ensure the requested services are properly performed as per specifications
c) Quality: meet or exceed the quality standards set out in the contract specifications or the best practice in the cleaning and pest control industry
d) Time and budget: deliver the works set out in the Work Order within specified time and price, and to rectify and resolve with Principal any departures.
e) Professionalism: no disturbance or adversely affect the occupants of the premises
f) Environmental and sustainability: correctly remove rubbish and attention that there is no disposal of chemicals or contaminated water into the stormwater drains
g) Work, health and safety: comply with contractual and statutory requirements
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The successful respondent will be responsible in providing regular and on as needed based services for pest management for different council facilities.
The scopeof works also include associated works such as submitting reports and service programs and attendingprogress meetings etc.

sections.heading: Additional details/instructions

sections.content:
### Mandatory requirements
1. #### Modern slavery *
**Building and property - Facility maintenance**
This procurement category has a heightened risk of modern slavery.
You will be asked to provide information about modern slavery risks in your business and any actions you have taken to address these. You can visit the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner’s GRS webpage for more information.
Do you agree to provide this information?
**Response type**
Checkbox (Agree)
### Opportunity requirements
**1.**
**Licence requirement**
All pest management technicians carrying out the services must have the following qualifications and licence:
- A current NSW EPA Pest Management Technician License withthe relevant endorsement categories applicable to the servicesbeing performed and must meet the EPS competencyrequirements for those licence classes; and
- An Australian Qualification Framework (AQF) Level 3 qualification in pest management (Certificate III in Urban PestManagement or equivalent).
Have you provided documentary evidences in support of the above requirement?
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
**2.**
**Returnable Schedule**
Have you completed all schedules? This includes the acknoweledgement of the receipt of Addendum in schedule 17.
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
**3.**
**Pricing Schedule**
Have you completely filled in the pricing schedule for all parts from A to E in Annexure C?
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
**4.**
**Work, Health and Safety forms**
In the RFT package, we have included forms (1) WHS051.5 and (2) WHS051.11 to be completed and duly signed.
Have you attached the returnable WHS forms as outlined above?
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
**5.**
**Insurance**
Have you attached copies of valid Certificate of Currencies for the required insurances?
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
